module: Flowgraph node "Fade To Black" (category once_f_duration): fades the screen to black. Input "duration" (0.75 s). Duration output via setDurationState (flow "complete", former name "done"). Goes directly to 'finished' if the screen is already black (ui_fadeScreen.isBlack).
notes: Sets self.mgr.modules.ui.isFadeScreenActive = true so that Fade From Black knows a fade is active.

_executionStopped.desc: Resets the 'inactive' state and isFadeScreenActive = false.

state.desc: Screen fade state (1 = black reached, 3 = fade finished).
